refinements.why: Both are Hex describing its own agent's internals — subagents that split an analysis into parallel workstreams, and one built to improve charts. The customer creates, names and configures nothing. Sanctioned by the rung's Test clause, excluded by its Boundary clause; the chart row says 'an agent you configure once with its own instructions and tools', which is the Boundary reading.
